title: BLR acceptance probability
statement: For a function $f:\bbf_2^n\to\bbf_2$, define its BLR acceptance probability as the probability that $f(x)+f(y)=f(x+y)$ when $x$ and $y$ are chosen independently and uniformly from $\bbf_2^n$.
